claims.text: For 3–4 episodes/yr despite treating risk factors: prophylaxis for 1–12 months may be considered;
claims.quote: Prophylactic antibiotics such as benzathine penicillin 1.2 million units IM monthly or penicillin V or erythromycin 250 mg orally 2 times a day for 1 to 12 months may be considered for patients who have 3 to 4 episodes of cellulitis per year despite treatment of risk factors.

claims.text: continue until risk factors are managed.
claims.quote: Antibiotics should be continued until risk factors also have been managed.
